description: This file contains utility functions for DOM manipulation used internally by Leaflet, including style property detection, element creation/removal, class management, positioning, and event handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns an element given its DOM id, or returns the element itself if passed directly.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the computed style value for a specific attribute on an element.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an HTML element with specified tag, class, and optional container.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an element from its parent node.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Removes all children from an element.

methods.name: toFront
methods.description: Brings an element to the front of its parent's children.

methods.name: toBack
methods.description: Sends an element to the back of its parent's children.

methods.name: hasClass
methods.description: Checks if an element has a specific CSS class.

methods.name: addClass
methods.description: Adds a CSS class to an element.

methods.name: removeClass
methods.description: Removes a CSS class from an element.

methods.name: setClass
methods.description: Sets the class attribute of an element.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Retrieves the class attribute of an element.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of an element, with support for older IE.

methods.name: setTransform
methods.description: Applies a CSS transform to translate and optionally scale an element.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Positions an element at specified coordinates using CSS transforms or top/left.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the last set position of an element.

methods.name: disableTextSelection
methods.description: Prevents text selection on the page.

methods.name: enableTextSelection
methods.description: Re-enables text selection on the page.

methods.name: disableImageDrag
methods.description: Prevents dragging of images.

methods.name: enableImageDrag
methods.description: Re-enables dragging of images.

methods.name: preventOutline
methods.description: Hides the outline of an element to prevent focus outlines.

methods.name: restoreOutline
methods.description: Restores the outline of an element after being hidden.

methods.name: getSizedParentNode
methods.description: Finds the closest parent node with non-zero size.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Calculates the CSS scale applied to an element.
